featured_reviews.review_text:
Living here has been a disappointing experience due to the management's conduct. The Society Chairperson and Secretary are consistently biased in their decision-making, often favoring certain residents while ignoring the valid concerns of others.

featured_reviews.name: Nabeel Ahmad
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s one of the best project in Mumbai and off-course top in Mahim, best part is location, project plan, amenities and view. Project walkthrough, presentation and suggestions given by Mr Kushal Khanna made us convinced to consider the project and in addition to that very detailed explanation on every aspect of each flat was also provided. At last we met Mr Harpreet, the site head, who was phenomenal from all aspect of professional and personal, minute architecture and design level details with good deal were also given. We came back with happy deal and great connection with these two gentlemen. Looking forward for this amazing project delivery and relationship with L&T and team.

featured_reviews.name: Jayendu Vaidya
featured_reviews.review_text:
The project is good, and I have no complaints about the project. However, I do have to share a very disappointing experience I had when I visited a couple of days ago, and that is with respect to the Sales Manager at the site.

I was directed to her for a query I had, and was asked to wait. She did come to the waiting area and Receptionist pointer her to me. However, the lady just turned away and started to walk back, without even acknowledging us. I grant that she might be too busy for our small query but she lacked the basic courtesies expected of a Sales Manager.

I am an existing investor, but she had scant respect.

The project by itself being developed and promoted by L&T caters to the upwardly mobile segment though credibility is best seen vide quality construction and adherence to construction timelines. Out of the 3 towers ( all 28 floors plus), the first two towers are nearly sold out. This is no greenfield project. A SRA.

Looks good. Construction on time albeight too early to predict. Hoping L&T Realty takes corrective measures with respect to the few past observations concerning roof leakages etc. Knowing the group, they have a winner on hand.

The pics are of the nearby St.Michaels church, an iconic and therapeutic place of worship.

Actually our cousins live here. So we were strolling in the compound the other day and I cannot express in words how disappointed I was on seeing such cheap finishing. I don’t know if it’s just incomplete (they moved almost a year ago. Does it really take that long?) or it’s intended to be that way. So instead of walls, at the backside of the building there are ‘patras’. You know the ones that you find at construction sites and in chawl houses. It spoils the whole show of a “premium” project. And these guys have paid above ₹5 crores to live here. Does the builder not have any sense? I wonder if majority of the flats are even sold. Paying 5 crores and being treated to ‘patras’ while walking along the compound. It gives such a cheap feeling.

Even the parking lot was supposed to have a nice design but it’s just left open with cheap nets. Makes you really wonder if the cost wasn’t recovered by the builder on account of flats being left unsold. There is no green garden area as promised. It’s just mud lying around which looks so bad and children can’t even play there. They’d promised a nice garden with lush greenery and seats but as I mentioned, it’s all barren land.
Rest everything is good. They have security measures in place, a nice lobby, well maintained passages, waste disposal system and everything but the moment you step out of the building and into the compound you’re gonna be disappointed. Also the views on the east side is disappointing. The flats, especially lower floors overlook a massive slum and even the higher floors don’t have a great view because another tall building happens to be right in front of it.
